title: Camera Ingest Preflight
user: 360° and mixed-camera photographers checking a card before DAM import
job: Scan a local folder read-only and report format, preview, projection, orientation, duplicate, camera and GPS risks before import.
success_measure: Identify 95% of files a configured downstream library would reject or misclassify in a 50-card beta.
privacy: Local-first. GPS coordinates are never included in exported reports unless explicitly requested.
monetization: Free scan and JSON/CSV export; one-time paid migration report presets.
